# SUnorderedList `<s-unordered-list>`

A bulleted list. `SUnorderedList` is the typed Vue 3 wrapper for Shopify's Polaris `<s-unordered-list>` web component.

```ts
import { SUnorderedList } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
```

## Best practices

- **Use it when order doesn't matter.** An unordered list presents related items, such as features, options or benefits, with no sequence or ranking. When the sequence matters, use `SOrderedList` instead.
- **Keep items parallel.** Give every item the same grammatical structure so the list is easy to scan. Mixing writing styles in one list makes it harder to read.
- **Write short items.** Lists work best when each item is brief. If items grow long or complex, consider breaking the content into separate sections.
- **Limit nesting.** Nested lists can organize hierarchical content, but they get hard to follow quickly. If you need more than two levels, the content may not suit a list.

See [Shopify's best practices for `<s-unordered-list>`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/layout-and-structure/unordered-list#best-practices) for the full guidance.

```vue
<script setup>
import { SUnorderedList, SOrderedList, SListItem, SStack } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
</script>

<template>
  <SStack direction="inline" gap="large-500" alignItems="start">
    <!-- SUnorderedList renders its SListItem children as a bulleted list. -->
    <SUnorderedList>
      <SListItem>Free shipping over $50</SListItem>
      <SListItem>30-day returns</SListItem>
      <SListItem>24/7 customer support</SListItem>
    </SUnorderedList>
    <SOrderedList>
      <SListItem>Add items to your cart</SListItem>
      <SListItem>Review your order</SListItem>
      <SListItem>Confirm and check out</SListItem>
    </SOrderedList>
  </SStack>
</template>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `any` | The content of the UnorderededList. Accepts only `ListItem` components. |
| `id` | `string \| undefined` | A unique identifier for the element. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | The list entries displayed within the unordered list, where each item is marked with a bullet point. Only accepts list item components as children. Each list item represents a single bulleted entry in the list. |
